Use whenever the user asks for an acting pass, a dialogue scene, a confrontation, a "make the acting better" fix, a performance that looks flat or over-acted, or says "film-acting" / "acting skill". Also use to rewrite an existing video prompt whose take came back with stiff faces, shouting with no build, or both characters talking at once.

name: film-acting-task-before-emotion
description: 用于演员知道场景目标却无法哭、无法愤怒或开始强迫复制预设情绪，用户说“感觉没来 / forced emotion / 特写要落泪”时。把注意力移回对手、真实物件、感官与具体任务，让情绪作为行动结果涌现。不用于建立完整角色背景，也不否定剧情所需的安全生理效果。

name: film-acting-who-am-i-preparation
description: 用于演员开拍前建立角色当下生活，用户问“我是谁、在哪里、和谁、刚发生什么、要什么、什么阻挡 / given circumstances”时。按身份—环境—关系—前事—需求—障碍—行动生成可排练行为。不用于筛选整个人物前史或处理预设情绪未出现。

name: film-action-design-coach-image-pipeline
description: 用于动作任务和胜负后果已经成立，需要把招式设计、演员或替身训练、现场动作指导与影像化排成阶段交付时，输出动作分解、安全门、排练计划和拍摄接口。不用于动作场的剧情任务尚未成立；输入尚未确认动作场必要性时改用 film-action-story-task-motivation。

name: film-action-feature-camera-emotion-map
description: 用于动作节拍已经设计并能安全重复，当前要选择景别、角度、屏幕方向和摄影机运动，使攻防因果清楚且传达角色恐惧、优势或失衡时，交付动作地理图与机位表。不用于动作尚未经过安全设计和重复排练；输入尚未成为安全可重复的动作时改用 film-action-design-coach-image-pipeline。

name: film-action-story-task-motivation
description: 用于尚未决定动作场是否应存在、人物为何此刻必须诉诸动作、胜负会改变什么时，交付动作任务、开打理由、升级节拍与结束状态。不用于纯竞技、MV或演示项目已明确不承担剧情功能；输入已经是获准保留的动作任务时改用 film-action-design-coach-image-pipeline。

name: film-advisor
description: Explicit-only front door for a bounded AI film-production workflow.

name: film-analysis-description-citation-context
description: 用于电影分析论证尚未分清三类材料：银幕上可描述的事实、可定位的影片引述、以及访谈档案等外围资料；输出分层证据表和论证链。不用于已有完整三层证据，只需分析技巧的全片模式；输入已经有可定位的镜头证据时改用 film-analysis-part-whole-loop。

name: film-analysis-part-whole-loop
description: 用于已经掌握可定位的镜头证据，当前要检验某种构图、色彩、声音或剪辑技巧在全片如何重复、变化、反转并服务整体形式时，输出模式表和可修正的整体解释。不用于影片证据和外围资料尚未分层；输入尚未区分影片证据与外围资料时改用 film-analysis-description-citation-context。

name: film-animatic
description: Draft a film or drama episode as a voiced storyboard animatic before any video is bought, with a still per shot, app screens built as scenes, every line voiced at its shot's time, cut with captions and watched until the user says yes. Use when a film's story and shots are worked on stills and sound first.

name: film-animation-blocking
description: Maya blocking helpers for film shot animation contexts.

name: film-app-demo
description: Film a short demo video of the user's own iOS app (in the iOS Simulator) or native Mac app with ShowTake, then export App Store App Previews, the App Store header video, social cuts (X, TikTok, Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn) or App Store screenshots. Use when the user asks for a demo, launch, promo or App Store preview video, app screenshots, or to re-shoot a saved demo for a new build or language.

name: film-architecture-loop
description: Run the film-framework loop — sweep the framework (packages/film and the app's code beside its films) against prior art, the north stars, measured performance, the lab and the open review items; apply, counsel, live-check, until a pass finds polish only.

name: film-art-direction
description: 电影美术指导 skill。将叙事情绪翻译成可直接用于 AI 生成模型的视觉元素清单，输出颗粒度到道具级（颜色、材质、光质、服装、空间线条）。适用于艺术指导阶段，输入为场景情绪状态，输出为可被 Lumen Planner Agent 直接使用的视觉描述。当用户需要为场景定义美术风格、色彩方案、道具清单、灯光质感时使用。

name: film-assemble
description: Assembles the rendered clips into one final cut — concatenates them in the edit-plan order (straight cuts), lays in the music bed, and adds subtitles (burned-in or soft) via ffmpeg, saving projects/project-name/final.mp4. Use after the clips are rendered (/film-render) and the edit/sound/subtitle plans exist, to produce the actual deliverable. Local/free; needs ffmpeg.
allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Bash

name: film-assembler
description: Assemble animated GIF shots into an H.264 MP4 with FFmpeg and optional original or licensed audio.

name: film-assembly
description: Cut the final film with ffmpeg - normalise clips to one size/fps, join with cuts or crossfades (optionally snapped to music beats), lay narration over a ducked music bed, and export for 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5. Use when all shots and audio are approved.

name: film-asset-character
description: 把剧本里的一个人做成可复用的角色资产：填满设定卡字段、出三视图与表情板、建 10–20 张参考图集、绑定 Soul ID／参考图权重／种子等一致性锚点，并用 10/10 压力测试过关。建角色、定装、跨镜头保脸保人设时用。

name: film-asset-generator
description: 当用户提供剧本文件和影视资产文件，或提供包含两者的项目文件夹，并要求自动生成真人短剧、影视剧、电影、广告或其他视听项目的人物、场景、道具资产时，使用本 Skill。必须读取剧本建立统一世界观，严格以资产文件中的明确描述为最高优先级，自动批量生成人物三视图、场景设计方案和独立道具图，并执行质量控制、去重、角色一致性检查、断点续跑、角色定稿和最终报告。不是单纯提示词生成器；在可用生图执行器存在时，目标是实际生成并保存最终 PNG 资产文件。

name: film-asset-qc
description: 用资产护照、压力测试矩阵与角色动画 QA 检查点给资产判生死：角色 10/10 才锁，角色/地点/道具逐项打勾，miss 不许平均，返修按 P0–P3 排队。开拍前验收、跨镜头漂移排查、交付前终检时用。

name: film-asset-scene-prop
description: 把剧本里的空间与物件做成可复用资产：场景出四向视图与反打、写平面布局与光照基调，道具出多视角细节板并建「道具—使用镜头」对照表。要搭景、定空间、锁道具形制，或同一空间多机位时用。

name: film-asset-style-bible
description: 用一页纸锁死全片美术语言：把 noir／cyberpunk／epic／fantasy／horror／romance／war 拆成色彩、材质、光线、构图、镜头、声音六维参数，定主锚点与禁止清单，并给冲突裁决顺序。开拍前定调与跨部门对齐时用。

name: film-audio-loudness
description: 按交付平台定响度目标，用 ffmpeg loudnorm 两遍法做线性归一，必要时先上真峰值限幅，编码后再复测真峰值与时长。成片混音收尾、平台退片、声音忽大忽小时用。

name: film-audio-python
description: Analyze a local film throughout its timeline, design a frame-accurate sound cue sheet, and create synchronized sound effects and original music with local Python. Use for film sound design or scoring requests, not for audio transcription alone.

name: film-audio-reaper-mix
description: Import a locked film and its generated music, Foley, ambience, and SFX into REAPER, mix against picture, and deliver a verified final audio master. Use when the user wants REAPER to finish an existing film audio package.

name: film-audio-sound-design
description: 把分镜翻成可检索的声音需求，按动作、材质、时长与许可选音效，用节拍网格把切点钉到拍上，再按层级铺 BGM 与 SFX 并做闪避。需要配乐选型、找音效、卡点剪辑、混音层级或交付双版本时用。

name: film-audio-video-finish
description: Assemble, mix, master, and render a locked film with the separate music, Foley, ambience, and effects created by film-audio-python. Use when the user wants a finished video with its soundtrack, not merely audio cue generation.

name: film-audio-voiceover
description: 把旁白稿做成可剪辑的配音音轨：按语言、情绪与预算选 TTS 引擎，写可执行的表演指令，逐句核算时间窗并做有上限的语速补偿，最后校验音画与口型同步。需要配音、旁白、角色台词、换声重配时用。

name: film-board
description: Build a 9:16 scroll-snap HTML board an owner talks over in Cap: one claim per frame, accumulating charts, a dummy ledger that reconciles, Reels safe band, current-client brand tokens. Use when the user says "film board", "make the HTML for the reel", "scroll explainer", "Cap board", "talking-head HTML", "9:16 board", "educational reel page", or wants a page to walk while recording phone-vertical. Also fire before a Cap sitting when the topic is a number-story (cash, margin, seats, a process).

name: film-box-office-comparison
description: Compare theatrical film grosses through Crawlora Box Office Mojo charts, title/release records, and stored data. Use for comparable-film briefs, domestic/international mix, release-window comparisons, or franchise performance with title, release, currency, and reporting basis preserved.

name: film-breakdown
description: Measure a film someone hands you (cuts, contact sheets, motion energy, beat grid, colours) and compare a recreation against it frame by frame. Use for "recreate this", "make one like this", "what makes this work", "match this pacing" or "time it to this track".

name: film-breakdown
description: Build scene plans and shot cards from scripts or ideas.

name: film-breakdown-distiller
description: Discover, analyze, and distill films, scenes, clips, reference videos, shot breakdowns, and film-study notes into reusable film-language mechanisms, directing rules, and AI-video prompt controls. Use for 拉片、视频拆解、参考视频复刻/裂变、原创建构、shot craft lessons, mechanism-bank updates, or translating a reference's narrative/emotional/conversion functions into a new project while replacing its protected or signature expression. Evidence boundaries are mandatory.

name: film-burn
description: Film Burn: Hot glowing holes or a flare burn across A like overheated film and reveal B. claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills && claude plugin install varg@varg

name: film-burn-transition
description: Use for film burn transition. Use short stylized light gradients and controlled opacity tied to cut.

name: film-camera-focus-risk-configuration
description: 用于机位、镜头、距离和光圈方案基本确定，当前要根据景深、运动、遮挡和失焦后果决定跟焦人员、测距系统、距离标记与排练级别时，输出焦点风险表和执行配置。不用于机位、焦距或光圈仍在变化；输入仍在选择机位、焦距、距离和光圈时改用 film-camera-perspective-depth-composition。

name: film-camera-image-chain-test-gate
description: 用于开拍前验证摄影机、镜头、记录格式、监看变换、后期色彩管理和最终显示的端到端链路，并决定哪些参数可锁定时，交付测试素材、跨显示评估和批准基线。不用于只需为一个镜头选择机位、焦距或景深；对象是单个镜头的机位、焦距、取景和景深时改用 film-camera-perspective-depth-composition。

name: film-camera-perspective-depth-composition
description: 用于把故事要求落实到单个镜头的机位、焦距、拍摄距离和光圈，联合决定透视、取景与景深时，交付光学方案和实机验证点。不用于故事层视觉目标尚未确定；输入是故事或段落命题时改用 film-cinematography-story-to-visual-strategy。

name: film-captions
description: Add styled, word-timed captions to any video, and do nothing else (picture and sound are untouched). Four styles - clean, karaoke (spoken word lights up), box, punch (1-3 big words for Shorts/Reels). Uses existing word timings or transcribes locally. Use for "add captions/subtitles to this video", and as the caption stage of film-studio. Not for talking-head embed effects (use embedded-captions).

name: film-card
description: Завести или дозаполнить справочную карточку тайтла в Кино Базе — поля films-data.json, идентификаторы IMDb, Кинопоиска и TMDB, аннотацию, постер, теги и сезоны сериала. Use when пользователь просит завести фильм или сериал в базу, добавить тайтл, обновить справку, найти постер, проставить теги, уточнить сезоны или дату выхода. Триггеры — «заведи фильм», «добавь тайтл в базу», «занеси сериал», «обнови справку», «найди постер», «проставь теги», «сколько сезонов вышло», «уточни дату выхода».

name: film-cast-actor-database
description: Research a film's credited performers, infer evidence-based casting categories from their wider work, and publish a sourced actor database with recent-film evidence to Google Sheets. Use when a user supplies a film title or link for actor or casting research.

name: film-cast-design
description: Make a film's people, props and places consistent on pictures - line-keyed descriptors, one sheet per person and one plate per prop compiled by the server, reading an asset review, cutting each panel into its own view, locking the approved asset, and the user's own photos kept as they came. Use when a film needs its cast, props or places designed, pictured, locked or repaired.

name: film-character-inner-outer-life
description: 用于角色前史过多、人物小传难以转成银幕行为，或演员/编剧问“哪些童年经历该保留 / backstory vs observable behavior”时。区分影片前形成性内在生活与片中通过选择揭示的外在生活。不用于当前场景的目标动作指导或情绪催生。

name: film-character-need-obstacle-action
description: 用于人物没有推动力、场景缺冲突、没有反派却要持续产生戏，或用户问“角色想要什么、什么阻挡、下一步怎么做 / objective-obstacle-action”时。用需求—障碍—动作建立逐场因果发动机。不用于抽象主题提炼或完整三幕转折布局。

name: film-cinematography-master
description: 用于分析、讲解和指导电影运镜技巧——涵盖所有基础运镜（推拉摇移跟升降甩）和进阶技法（滑动变焦、斯坦尼康、长镜头等），以及希区柯克、库布里克等10+位导演的标志性运镜风格。当用户询问镜头语言、导演风格、场景分析或拍摄建议时使用。

name: film-cinematography-story-to-visual-strategy
description: 用于把故事、人物关系或场景命题翻译成全片或段落级的视点、构图、摄影机运动、曝光、光色和质感规则时，交付视觉策略表与发展节点。不用于只需计算一个镜头的焦距、透视或景深；输入是已明确的单镜头关系目标时改用 film-camera-perspective-depth-composition。

name: film-companion
description: Provides pre- and post-viewing context for a specific film to make it more rewarding to watch. Pre-viewing mode primes attention without spoilers — why the film matters, its moment in cinema history, what to watch for, and the right frame of mind to bring. Post-viewing mode enriches after viewing — what the viewer likely missed, what contemporary audiences experienced that modern viewers don't, production backstory, and the critical debates worth knowing. Strictly no spoilers in pre-viewing mode. Do NOT use for film reviews, recommendation lists ("what should I watch"), standalone plot summar…

name: film-component
description: Render a video of an audio/ui component with the Remotion app in apps/video (a new component, an updated one, the whole library, or the teaser), or add or fix a component's showcase. Use when the user asks for a video, a clip, a render or a teaser of a component.

name: film-continuity
description: Keep a film consistent from the first shot to the last like a real animation studio - one model sheet per character, one medium (never switch between 2D and 3D), one world and lighting logic, screen direction and the 180-degree rule, eyelines, matching action across cuts, and carrying state (props, damage, hair, mess) from scene to scene. Use for every film with recurring characters or places.

name: film-continuity-state-ledger
description: 用于非顺拍、跨日重拍、补拍、换脸或剪辑交接，需要记录和恢复动作、视线、服化道、光声、对白与表演状态，用户说“continuity log / 连戏基线 / 这条怎么接”时。建立多维状态账本。不用于有意的不连续设计或一般制作变更控制。

name: film-copilot
description: A step-by-step co-pilot for making any video — at each stage it stops and asks the user a few multiple-choice questions (tap an option, no typing) about the things people tend to forget or skip and that change the result or waste time, credits, context, energy or storage; it also watches for common bad habits and fixes them silently. Use at the START of every video/film/animation/edit project, before each stage of a project (story, images, generating, editing, sending), when the user says "let's make a video", "new film", "start a project", "copilot", "what am I forgetting", "check before I s…

name: film-costume-continuity
description: Design character look boards, scene-specific costumes, coordinated colour palettes, and visual costume continuity for one entire screenplay, then assemble a detailed PDF costume bible. Use when the user supplies a film script and wants character-to-scene-to-costume planning with generated designs and links between repeated or changing looks.

name: film-craft
description: Use for film craft shared by code-built and AI-generated video - planning shots and camera, acting for code-posed characters, lighting a scene, cutting and sound in the edit, quality gates before a preview or final, breaking down a reference video, transcribing audio, naming the music in a video, or fixing his note on a shot of a code-built or 3D film (a pose, a camera move, a cut).

name: film-creation
description: AIGC 影视创作参考包，覆盖 AI 图像 / 视频作品从故事到提示词的全流程。用户提出这些需求时调用：故事、概念、treatment / 梗概；剧本与改编、台词 / 对白、伏笔与反转等叙事技巧、按类型写（悬疑、爱情、喜剧、恐怖、动作、科幻、家庭、广告）、剧本诊断；角色设计、表演与跨镜头一致；情绪效果（哭、笑、怕、爽）；分镜脚本（一场戏拆几个镜头）、镜间承接（分镜像打卡、镜头之间缺因果和过渡）、分镜图、连续性、节奏；镜头语言（景别、角度、运镜、焦段、光、构图、转场）、色彩与质感、器材与格式；图像 / 视频提示词，含按分镜脚本写多镜头长提示词、一镜到底、首尾帧与生成方式、选模型（Seedance、Kling、Veo、Wan、SDXL 等）；参考图与资产一致性；声音、配乐与剪辑；导演 / 摄影风格参考与混搭（125 位导演、29 位摄影指导）、风格卡；迭代与交付；竖屏短剧 / 漫剧（立项、出海、分集大纲、单集剧本、拆解、分镜、片段提示词、成片质检）。默认输出 AIGC 产物；实拍只在用户明确要求时回答。Triggers: story, treatment, logline, screenplay, script, adaptation, dialogue, foreshadowing, plot twist, genre, character design, storyboard,…

name: film-creator
description: AI-powered film creation assistant that transforms a single sentence or image into a complete 30-second film. Automatically generates screenplay with scenes, dialogue, and camera directions, then produces cinematic video. Use when user wants to create a movie, film, or video story from text or image input. Trigger phrases: '创作电影', '生成电影', 'film creator', 'make a movie', 'create a film'.

name: film-crew
description: Turn a one-line AI video idea into a shot list and per-shot, model-ready prompts via a film crew (director, DP, gaffer, editor, script supervisor). Also fixes failing video prompts and diagnoses bad clips before a reroll. Works with Wan, LTX, Kling, Veo, Seedance, Hailuo, Runway.

name: film-crew
description: Run Guaardvark's five-role Film Crew locally: screenwriter, casting (Cast Library LoRAs), cinematographer storyboards, keyframe renders, editor. Turns a logline or screenplay into a finished short video with human gates at casting and storyboard. Use when the user says "film this", "make a short film", "storyboard this script", or "start the film crew".

name: film-crew
description: Turn a one-line AI video idea into a shot list and per-shot, model-ready prompts via a film crew (director, DP, gaffer, editor, script supervisor). Also fixes failing video prompts and diagnoses bad c

name: film-crew
description: AI film crew for multi-shot film, scene, trailer, music-video or ad pre-production. Seven departments work in a fixed order — Director, Production Designer, Costume Designer, Cinematographer (DP), Editor, Camera Operator, Sound Designer — so each shot is planned knowing the shots around it and the generated clips cut together. Delivers director's script, world bible, camera & light plan, pre-edit with a handoff contract per cut, exact camera moves, sound plan, storyboard, keyframe + video prompts and a generation plan, in the style of any named director, cinematographer or film — 12 lenses re…

name: film-critic
description: Produces publication-ready film reviews covering all five cinematic dimensions (narrative, performance, direction, cinematography, sound/score) with evidence-grounded analysis, precise cinema vocabulary, and a mandatory skeleton-draft-critique-revise cycle.

name: film-cut
description: Designs the edit/cut-connection plan (cut order, rhythm, transitions, continuity) from the shots/clips using the wiki editing theory, saving to projects/project-name/edit-plan.md. Use when the user wants to edit, connect cuts, or plan the assembly of clips.
allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Bash

name: film-cutting
description: Cut a film's accepted takes into one scene - the montage bootstrap with hard cuts, separate dialogue and ambience, and diagnosing a bad join before choosing the smallest repair.
